items.difficulty_reason: Geometrically reduced + connected + dimension 1 locus: in the Stein factorization X -> T -> S of a CM family with geometrically reduced fibres the morphism T -> S is etale, and the component S_1 of the finite locally free decomposition is the open and closed subscheme over which fibres are geometrically connected; base-change invariance follows from constancy of the number of connected components of geometric fibres. Retained author proof at lines 1308-1340.
